facts.label: Planos e ofertas
facts.sub: Use going to para planos e I’ll para ofertas e decisões na hora: I’m going to make rice. I’ll bring the plates.

facts.label: Planos
facts.sub: Use am/is/are going to + verbo base para planos: I’m going to make rice and chicken. Negativa: I’m not going to make dessert. Pergunta: Are you going to cook?

facts.label: Oferta
facts.sub: Use I’ll + verbo base quando decide na hora ou oferece ajuda: I’ll bring plates. I’ll buy ice cream. I’ll é a forma curta de I will. Neste nível, use só a forma afirmativa.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Going to is for plans we already have.
I’ll is a good way to offer help.
After will, we use to + verb.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Going to is for plans we already have. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
I’ll is a good way to offer help. → Verdadeiro (Yes: I’ll bring a salad.)
After will, we use to + verb. → Falso (We use the base verb.)

pages.title: A bright kitchen · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Friday afternoon in a bright kitchen in Auckland. Fresh vegetables sit on the counter. Mia puts on her apron. Her friend Ines stops by with a bag. Mia is going to cook for six people. Ines wants to help.
“Hi, Mia! Are you cooking for your friends tonight?” says Ines. “Yes! I’m going to make a big pot of rice and chicken.” says Mia. “Nice! Are you going to make dessert too?” says Ines.
